sections.section_path: introduction > Purpose of Communications Management Plan
sections.instruction: [Provide the purpose of the communication management plan.]
sections.boilerplate: The overall objective of a Communications Management Plan is to promote the success of a project by meeting the information needs of project stakeholders. TheCommunications Management Plan (CMP)defines the project’s structure and methods of information collection, screening, formatting, and distribution and outline understanding among project teams regarding the actions and processes necessary to facilitate the critical links among people, ideas, and information that are necessary for project success. The intended audience of theCMP isthe project manager, project team, project sponsor and any senior leaders whose support is needed to carry out communication plans.
